subject: Interim remediation response & audit window clarification for FinBank SOC 2 request
messages:
From: Samantha Hill <samantha.hill@evergreen-audit.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jacob Reed <security@finbank.com>
Date: 2025-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II follow-up: exception evidence and bridge letter window

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks again for sending the access details last week. As we prepare for FinBank's vendor review, we need two items to close the outstanding exception:

1) A short management response for the exception on change management (high-severity) describing root cause and corrective actions taken.
2) Interim evidence showing control operation during the current audit window (2025-06-01 to 2025-10-31), or a bridge letter if changes occurred after the period.

Please confirm whether you can provide a bridge letter that ties remediation to the audit window, or if you will supply time-stamped evidence (logs/config snapshots) for the period above. If you have an updated remediation tracker, attach it.

Can we get the response and evidence by COB Nov 24 to stay on FinBank's review timeline? If not, propose the earliest feasible date and we’ll escalate on our side.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Hill
Senior Auditor, Evergreen Audit LLP

--
Attachment: none (please attach management response / tracker)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Hill <samantha.hill@evergreen-audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II follow-up: exception evidence and bridge letter window

Samantha —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary and next steps from our side:

- Management response: attached (management-response-exception-2025-11.docx). It includes root cause, timeline of corrective actions, and the owner for each action item.
- Interim evidence: we have captured configuration snapshots and access logs covering 2025-06-01 through 2025-10-31 for the affected service. Due to SIEM retention limits, some raw logs beyond 90 days are archived; we can provide signed CSV extracts and a verification statement.
- Bridge letter: we can produce a bridge letter to explicitly state control remediation completed and the dates it became effective; we recommend the bridge letter reference remediation completion date of 2025-11-12.

Attached is our remediation tracker (remediation-tracker-FinBank-Nov2025.xlsx) with status and expected closure dates. Two asks for you so we align:

1) Do you prefer a bridge letter dated to the remediation completion (Nov 12) or words tying the interim evidence to the audit window?
2) Will a signed verification + extracted logs be acceptable instead of full raw event logs?

If those are fine, we'll upload the Drive folder with the extracted evidence and the bridge letter draft by Nov 24. If FinBank requires raw event exports for the full audit period, we'll need until Nov 28.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments:
- remediation-tracker-FinBank-Nov2025.xlsx
- management-response-exception-2025-11.docx

Samantha —

Confirming we will:

- Produce the bridge letter dated Nov 12, 2025 that calls out the remediation completion and the controls now in place.
- Upload extracted, signed CSVs for the relevant access events (2025-06-01 -> 2025-10-31) to the Drive folder linked below. Each file will include a checksum and a short verification statement from our engineering lead.
- Provide the remediation tracker with owner updates and closure ETA for remaining lower-severity items.

Drive evidence folder (will be shared with Evergreen Audit and FinBank): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRemediationEvidence

We expect to have the bridge letter draft + evidence uploaded by EOD Nov 24. If Evergreen needs the raw exports instead, note there will be a short delay to extract and re-sign due to archive retrieval.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II follow-up: exception evidence and bridge letter window

Marissa / Logan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the plan. A few clarifications from FinBank's side (copied Jacob):

- FinBank will accept the bridge letter dated Nov 12 as long as the interim evidence covers the audit window and the verification statement links the extracted CSV rows back to the archived raw logs.
- Please include a short paragraph in the bridge letter that explains why raw logs are archived (retention policy) and the process used to extract/verify the CSVs.
- Can you add a signature block for the engineering owner on the verification statements?

Let's do a 20-minute sync tomorrow (Nov 26) at 09:30 PT to confirm the Drive share and sign-off language. If you prefer, send the bridge letter draft now via DocuSign so we can review offline.

Thanks — looks like we're on track.
Samantha
